answer_2.quote: We evaluate the images with two methods: automatically comparing bounding boxes of objects and conducting human evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation on all images (referred to as ISM (Human)). Annotators are asked to compare the size/height of the objects in the images ... and classify the positional relationship between the person and the object. Each image is evaluated by two annotators, and the average performance is reported.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare size, compare height, and classify positional relationship between person and object in the generated images.
